# Farzad Hayat - Portfolio
> A personal portfolio and blog of Farzad Hayat, an agent-native software engineer in Brisbane, Australia. He builds with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Grok Bot, T3 Code) and builds for them: his platform Danzeira has a remote MCP server at https://danzeira.com/mcp.

## Navigation
- [Home](https://farzadhayat.dev/): The main portfolio page featuring work experience, projects, and education.
- [Blog](https://farzadhayat.dev/blog): Technical articles, tutorials, and insights.
- [Projects](https://farzadhayat.dev/projects): A showcase of technical projects and open-source work.
- [Resume](https://farzadhayat.dev/resume.pdf): Downloadable PDF resume.
